versions.changelog:
Agent Optimizer V6.1 released — a lightweight, dependency-free agent performance optimization framework.

- Records agent trajectories, metrics, and tool usage in a structured format.
- Supports multi-source reward feedback (user ratings, task completion, ROI) with trend analysis.
- Enables prompt optimization via A/B testing and version rollback.
- Provides tools for performance analysis and ROI tracking.
- Integrated into OpenClaw V6.1, requires no extra installation or dependencies.
